description:
HushTelegram v0.0.13 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.1 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 13.0.1 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 68 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: translate a whole chat, Folders by chat type, Save downloaded files, UnifiedPush notifications for phones without working Firebase, Faster downloads, a black launch screen with AMOLED black, HushTelegram's own icon and name, and switches that hide the Contacts tab, channel bar buttons, the Send as button or messages that match your keyword filters. HushTelegram settings is split into seven pages.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 959 runtime tests passed locally. All 419 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 68 patches applied to Telegram 13.0.1 and the 13.0.1 beta without forcing, and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, native libraries and alignment.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.0.1, version code 71679, or the beta 13.0.1, version code 71669. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from v0.0.12, patch 13.0.1 and install it over your current build with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram first and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
